draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.43, the 19th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 4th of 32 at WR. He went 20th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Jarvis Landry. Testing standouts: 20-yard shuttle (100th percentile), three-cone (97th percentile). College production: 43 receiving yards in 2022, 32nd of 32 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Seattle Seahawks. 51 career games and 36 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (16 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: team target share 35.8% (100th percentile), receiving yards 1,793 (100th percentile), approximate value 16 (99th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 wide receiver who played: 1,793 receiving yards against a median of 346, above the norm.
